description: This file defines classes and methods for module quality testing in an OpenERP/Odoo environment, including abstract test classes and specific quality check implementations.

classes.name: abstract_quality_check
classes.description: Abstract class for performing various quality tests on modules, with methods for running tests, formatting results, and managing test data.

classes.name: module_quality_check
classes.description: Model class representing a quality check for a module, capable of aggregating individual test results and calculating overall scores.

classes.name: module_quality_detail
classes.description: Model class representing detailed results of individual quality tests within a module quality check.

methods.name: run_test
methods.description: Abstract method to execute a specific quality test; to be implemented in subclasses.

methods.name: get_objects
methods.description: Retrieve all object model names associated with a given module.

methods.name: get_model_ids
methods.description: Get IDs of models matching specified model names.

methods.name: get_ids
methods.description: Get record IDs for a list of object models.

methods.name: format_table
methods.description: Format data as a wiki-style table.

methods.name: format_html_table
methods.description: Format data as an HTML table.

methods.name: add_quatation
methods.description: Calculate the quotient of two numbers.

methods.name: get_style
methods.description: Return CSS styles for HTML formatting.

methods.name: check_quality
methods.description: Calculate and return the overall quality score and detailed test results for a specified module.
